title: Keyboard Manager remapping key to open an app with args not working

status.label: Awaiting a current WSA launch test
status.detail: The report is from PowerToys 0.79.0 and does not identify the Run Program window behavior. Current builds distinguish showing an existing window from starting another process.

judgment.rationale: The reporter wants a WSA Calendar app launched with `WsaClient.exe /launch wsa://com.appgenix.bizcal.fire.pro` even when it is closed, but says the app opens only when already minimized. The report lists PowerToys 0.79.0 and no comments. Current Keyboard Manager has separate `Show Window` and `Start Another` behavior for Run Program shortcuts; the issue does not say which is selected. Retest the current configuration with `Start Another` before treating this as a code defect.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.79.0 and a WSA `WsaClient.exe /launch wsa://...` target.
The expected result is starting the Android Calendar app when closed; the actual result is that an already-minimized app window opens.
The issue has no comments or assignee and does not identify the configured Run Program window behavior.
Current Keyboard Manager supports distinct behavior for showing an existing window and starting another process.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the reporter to retest on v0.102.3001 with the Run Program behavior set to Start Another and the WSA app fully closed; request a fresh diagnostic only if that configuration still fails.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report predates the current Run Program behavior that distinguishes showing an existing window from starting another process, and it does not state which option is configured. A code fix is not applicable unless the current Start Another path still fails with the app closed.

comment.body:
The report says the WSA Calendar app opens when minimized but not when fully closed, and that a direct shortcut to `WsaClient.exe` with the launch URI works. Current Keyboard Manager has separate Run Program behavior for showing an existing window and starting another process. Could you please:
1. Retest on v0.102.3001 with the action set to **Start Another**, the WSA Calendar app fully closed, and the same launch URI.
2. If it still fails, share only the relevant mapping row and selected behavior, with personal paths redacted, and comment `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing.
This will distinguish an existing-window setting from a current WSA launch failure.
